Older reversals are already excluded because their originals are marked REVERSED.","decision":"fix","confidence":0.72,"pre_sql":[],"step_overrides":{"silver_transactions":"CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM raw_transactions r WHERE status = 'POSTED' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM raw_transactions rv WHERE rv.status = 'REVERSAL' AND rv.orig_txn_id = r.txn_id)"}}
